description: ELIGIBILITY - Feint::vf2 0x143fabac0 byte table at 0x143fabb44. Stagger (0x10) maps to case 1 = refuse; case 0 asks the cancel gate. Lets a stumbling player throw a shoulder/body feint to protect the ball. Emulated: Feint canStart(cur=Stagger) REFUSE -> GATED(vf14).
